name: khub
description: khub in the session: compact rows for khub calls, integrity warnings on writes, a status line, a band and a pane over the graph

binary.title: khub binary
binary.description: Command that runs khub. Empty resolves node_modules/.bin/khub, then khub on the path.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: on-request opens the pane on /khub or a click. wide also docks it at session start on wide terminals.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: advisory reports new check errors. block also keeps a turn from finishing while they remain.

agent_author.title: Agent author
agent_author.description: The author stamped on an entity the agent adds without naming one. Empty leaves it unset.

guard_new_files.title: Guard new entity files
guard_new_files.description: Deny a Write that creates a file inside a type's storage path, so entities are created with khub add.
